notes.title: Civic Story - Ver 1.0.4 Update
notes.content:
Hey Civic Story fans,

A new update has dropped to address small issues and update others. This Version 1.0.4 update features:

- Fixed: Players with certain resolution monitors reported difficulties pressing the new game button on the main menu. From what we can tell, this glitch has now been fixed.
- Small animation updates.
- Small content updates.
- Various minor bug fixes.

If you have downloaded Civic Story previously, please update to the newest version. If you discover an issue that our team missed, feel free to report it in-game by pressing F11 to send us a bug report. We hope to address any lingering bugs through new updates in the coming months. Thank you for your support of Civic Story!

notes.title: Introducing Civic Story
notes.content:
Our World is in danger, not from space aliens, super villains, or monsters, but from politics and the rampant apathy and divisiveness around them.

Introducing [i][b]Civic Story[/b][/i], a 3D Visual Novel... About Politics! Civic Story is a political parody where players are thrust into an election season, not as a politician or a decision maker, but as a regular citizen and marketer. As the election heats up and politicians make their promises, how does this have an affect on you and others? When the time comes to vote, who will you choose?

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44332600/72b88f22c3f3b573c1bc6705bbb29e458e1057d6.png[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Ripped from the headlines![/b] Experience an engaging satirical 8-Chapter storyline reflecting modern political challenges and how they affect the public.
[*] [b]It’s your choice! [/b]Interactive Point & Click Visual Novel with interactive conversations.
[*] [b]Choose your words![/b] Learn common Political terms, explore information, and create media headlines! Chose differently on each playthrough!
[*] [b]Welcome to the funny pages! [/b]A colourful, comic-inspired visual style realized in a 3D world full of quirky characters and comedic writing.
[*] [b]ABSURD Debates![/b] Observe Politicians discussing various topics in a bombastic and dramatic parody of political debates, which includes them shouting [b]NONSENSE[/b] at each other!
[/list]

Guided by research, consultants, and a passionate and diverse team at Shining Spark Entertainment, Civic Story will enlighten you on how politics affects different facets of our lives with a colourful cast of characters. You'll laugh and you might even cry learning the nuances of Canadian politics and how it affects the lives of others in this indie parody adventure!

Civic Story releases today alongside its original soundtrack, which can be purchased on its own or in a bundle. 

While the Civic Story is currently developed in English, we also hope to include a free French-Language update and potentially other bonuses at a later date.

Get your Vote on and get ready to shout [b]POPPYCOCK![/b] as you prepare to play Civic Story today.
